entries.title: Lars Vogel: Find blur filters and hidden text in your SVG icons
entries.description:
Our quest to make Eclipse RCP and SWT faster continues.
SWT renders SVG icons with JSVG on the UI thread, so everything inside an icon costs time.
Two kinds of leftovers turned out to be expensive in the Eclipse platform icons. Gaussian blur filters. JSVG computes every feGaussianBlur on each rasterization.
In 63 icons the blur did not change the result visibly, so we removed it .

entries.description: JetBrains has joined the Open Source Security Foundation (OpenSSF) as a general member. entries.title: VS Code v1_147: Agent experience
entries.description: Decision model-based model routers (Experimental) Setting:chat.copilot.modelRouter.enabled With a model router, you describe which model you want for which kind of work. A router is a YAML file in~/.agents/model-routers/that appears in the model picker inCopilot harnesssessions.

entries.title: VS Code v1_147: Editor Experience
entries.description: Customize panel corners and spacing Setting:workbench.sizeCustomizationsOpen in VS CodeOpen in VS Code Insiders Customize panel corners and spacing in the editor window and in Agents windows with the Modern UI enabled. Set corner radii in whole pixels from 0 to 8 and spacing from 0 to 16. For example, you can use square panel corners, add space between panels, and give agent chat panels their own corners:

entries.title: VS Code v1_147: Accessibility
entries.description: Clearer focus and session attention In high-contrast themes, Agents window controls now use a dashed outline for pointer hover and a solid outline for keyboard focus and open or expanded states. This makes it easier to follow your focus when navigating. Sessions that need input are also easier to spot: light themes use a clearer amber indicator, and high-contrast themes show a marker at the left edge of the session row. You can customize the color withagentSessionNeedsInput.foregroundinworkbench

entries.title: VS Code v1_147: MCP
entries.description: Skills over MCP Skills over MCP(SEP-2640) is now enabled by default, allowing MCP servers to automatically provide skills to the model. The first time you connect to an MCP server that provides skills, you are asked to allow them into your model context. Afterwards, the model can interact with these skills and you can see them on theSkillstab of the Agent Customizations editor.

entries.title: VS Code v1_147: Chat
entries.description: Attach screenshots of other apps (Experimental) Setting:chat.appWindowScreenshots.enabledOpen in VS CodeOpen in VS Code Insiders Give the agent a view of the app you're building, even when it runs in another application. SelectAdd Context>Screenshot App Windowand choose a window, such as a browser or simulator.

entries.title: VS Code v1_147: Agent sessions
entries.description: Send Later for chat requests (Experimental) Setting:sessions.sendLater.enabledOpen in VS CodeOpen in VS Code Insiders(Agents window only) Sometimes you want an agent to run a request after some time has passed. You might want to check a build after it finishes, or follow up on a review in the morning. With the Send Later feature, you can postpone sending a chat request until a specific time.
